Game Overview

Near Miss puts players into a arcade experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Near Miss keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Near Miss?

Near Miss is a free arcade game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Near Miss free to play?

Yes, Near Miss is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
